name: Jordan Reyes
tagline: Prospect with pending enterprise deal & unfulfilled technical promise

meetings.content: Meeting on November 14, 2025 with Jordan Reyes: Discussed budget and enterprise licensing tiers for the upcoming year. Jordan said current budget is locked for Q4 and explicitly said: 'let's revisit pricing next quarter.'

Meeting on December 19, 2025 with Jordan Reyes: Jordan raised a major concern about integration support with their legacy warehouse management system. I PROMISED to send a technical follow-up doc on integration support within 48 hours. As of today this has NOT been sent — this is an outstanding, unfulfilled commitment and is now significantly overdue.
Meeting on January 16, 2026 with Jordan Reyes: Light rescheduling call to align on calendar availability for our next working session. No major technical or pricing decisions discussed.

name: Elena Vance
tagline: Evaluating 3 vendors for autonomous fleet fleet management

meetings.content: Meeting on October 12, 2025 with Elena Vance: Initial product demo of core analytics capabilities. Discussed their Q4 roadmap. Elena mentioned they are evaluating 3 vendors for their autonomous fleet management.

Meeting on November 04, 2025 with Elena Vance: Explored single sign-on (SSO) and RBAC requirements. Provided documentation on SAML and Okta support. Elena confirmed requirements were completely satisfied.
Meeting on December 15, 2025 with Elena Vance: End-of-year sync. Elena mentioned their engineering team is locked until next budget cycle. All previous action items were fully resolved.

name: Marcus Chen
tagline: Technical lead finalizing cloud infrastructure evaluation

meetings.content: Meeting on September 18, 2025 with Marcus Chen: Technical architecture review regarding API latency and rate limits. Marcus confirmed standard tier limits are sufficient for their workloads.
Meeting on October 22, 2025 with Marcus Chen: Security questionnaire walkthrough. Compliance team cleared SOC2 Type II report with zero findings.
Meeting on November 29, 2025 with Marcus Chen: Catch-up on sandbox migration. Marcus reported migration was successful with no blockers or open questions.

name: Sarah Lin
tagline: Evaluating multi-region platform rollout & API SLA

meetings.content: Had an introductory scoping call with Sarah Lin. Discussed their Q2 multi-region deployment. I promised to send our SOC2 Type II compliance audit and pricing proposal by this Friday. Sarah said she will introduce us to their Head of Security once the package is reviewed.
